facts.text: John has been playing basketball since he was ten years old.

evidence.quote: Basketball has been a part of my life ever since I was a kid. I'd watch NBA games with my dad and dream of playing on those big courts. When I turned ten, dad signed me up for a local league, and I've been playing ever since.

facts.text: John was drafted by a team after earning a college scholarship.

evidence.quote: I kept playing through middle and high school before earning a college scholarship. And after college, I was drafted by a team – my dream come true!

facts.text: John's basketball shoes have been with him since he was ten years old.

evidence.quote: These have been with me on my journey since the beginning.
These are my lucky basketball shoes. They've been with me through the good and bad.

facts.text: John's number one goal is to win a championship.

evidence.quote: Winning a championship is my number one goal.
